name: Animation Policy
summary: Controls page motion by running image/GIF/SVG animations only once or disabling them entirely, which tests how a page behaves with animation removed (videos unaffected).
browsersNote: No Firefox or Edge listing found on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license or source link stated on the store page.
goodFor: Testing a page with animations stopped or played only once.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: animation reduced motion gif svg policy accessibility prefers-reduced-motion
